verdict.rationale: Bento's docs describe visual Workflows that start from a trigger and then run steps with branches, delays and decisions. Automations can also fire from events, form submissions and tags, alongside automated email Sequences, self-updating Segments and outbound webhook actions. Together these deliver background automation that runs autonomously once set up, and a homepage claim says AI can build flows from a plain-text description. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the automations running reliably, and detailed docs on AI-built flows (including whether the MCP server or CLI can create and manage workflows).
